physical.mounting-hardware: Support plate x1, 6 mm screw x5, spacer x4 (installation sheet)

configs.description: The manager as APC ships AR7580A.
configs.name: base

gaps.note: the installation sheet draws each finger in an isometric or face-on figure that is not dimensioned. Its height, length and the shape of its tip are read off the figure and estimated.
gaps.wanted: a section through a finger and the rail or back plate

gaps.note: the data sheet states no cable capacity, so none is recorded and none is estimated.
gaps.wanted: a capacity figure and the cable it is stated for

gaps.note: which NetShelter SX cabinets take this manager is stated only by the data sheet's title and the installation sheet's; no cabinet model number is listed, and the library has no NetShelter SX enclosure to place it in.
gaps.wanted: the maker's compatibility list, and the cabinet's accessory channel drawing

gaps.note: the installation sheet shows the manager hooked onto keyhole slots in the cabinet's accessory channel and held by screws; the slots' pitch and the hooks are not dimensioned and are not drawn.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned drawing of the manager fitted to the channel

gaps.note: the data sheet lists six cable retainers with snap hinges, shown in the installation sheet's inventory only; their size and places are not given and they are not drawn.
gaps.wanted: the retainers' size and where they clip on

gaps.note: the top securing bracket and the support plate are listed and drawn in the inventory, not dimensioned, and are not drawn.
gaps.wanted: their sizes and places on the plate

gaps.note: the part is two 20U lengths (the installation sheet's inventory: Vertical Cable Manager (2)); the joint is not dimensioned and the plate is drawn as one length.

gaps.wanted: no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: datasheet - "Color: Black", the provided equipment (installation guide, mounting hardware, six cable retainers with snap hinges, top securing bracket).

capacity.note: datasheet - no cable capacity is stated (see `gaps`).

chassis.note: datasheet - 97 x 1778 x 160: "Width 3.8 in (97 mm)", "Height 70 in (1778 mm)", "Depth 6.3 in (160 mm)".

color.note: estimated - "Color: Black". The shade is the library's render of black plastic.

depth.note: estimated - the 160 is the data sheet's; it is drawn as a 20 back plate zone and a 140 well. No view sections the part.

front.note: estimated - the working face: the back plate with its 40 fingers a side in two lengths of 20, and the channel between.

guides.note: estimated - the duct is the channel between the two finger columns, run down the height; the pitch is the rack unit of the data sheet's "1U increments", the gap the pitch less the 31 mm finger.

left.note: estimated - the back plate and the finger zone along it.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S OWN DOCUMENTS, read as data: the AR7580A data sheet and its installation sheet. Height, width, depth and weight are `datasheet`; the finger size and the split of the depth are ESTIMATED. No drawing or photograph is copied.

mount.note: datasheet - `rack-side`: "Number of rack unit 0U", "Mounting Location Front, Rear". The installation sheet hooks the plate onto the cabinet's accessory channel with support plate and screws. `ru: 40` is the 1778 mm in rack units. Which side is a placement's to say.

rear.note: estimated - the back of the plate, which stands against the cabinet; plain (see `gaps`).

right.note: estimated - the left view turned round.

shell.note: estimated - a hollow channel, not a box: the back plate as a well, the 80 fingers standing off its floor.

thickness.note: estimated - no document states a gauge; the parts carry their own.

top.note: estimated - the plan: the back plate zone and the two finger columns.

weight.note: datasheet - "Net Weight 9.02 lb(US) (4.09 kg)" for the part as sold (two lengths); packed 4.91 kg.
